import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Digital Camera Specifications Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Price vs Megapixels with Sensor Type
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sensor_types = df['sensor_type'].unique()
colors = sns.color_palette('husl', len(sensor_types))
for i, sensor in enumerate(sensor_types):
    subset = df[df['sensor_type'] == sensor]
    ax1.scatter(subset['megapixels'], subset['price_usd'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=50, label=sensor, color=colors[i])
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Sensor Type', fontsize=9, title_fontsize=10)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Average Price by Brand (top 10 brands by count)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
top_brands = df['brand'].value_counts().head(10).index
brand_price = df[df['brand'].isin(top_brands)].groupby('brand')['price_usd'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars = ax2.barh(brand_price.index, brand_price.values, color=sns.color_palette('viridis', len(brand_price)))
ax2.set_xlabel('Average Price (USD)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Brand', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Average Price by Brand (Top 10 Brands)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(True, axis='x', alpha=0.3)
for i, v in enumerate(brand_price.values):
    ax2.text(v + 50, i, f'${v:.0f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 3. Camera Evolution: Megapixels and 4K Adoption Over Time
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
year_stats = df.groupby('model_year').agg({
    'megapixels': 'mean',
    'has_video_4k': 'mean'
}).reset_index()
year_stats = year_stats.sort_values('model_year')

ax3_twin = ax3.twinx()
line1 = ax3.plot(year_stats['model_year'], year_stats['megapixels'], 
                 marker='o', linewidth=2, color='#2E86AB', label='Avg Megapixels')
line2 = ax3_twin.plot(year_stats['model_year'], year_stats['has_video_4k'] * 100, 
                      marker='s', linewidth=2, color='#A23B72', label='4K Video (%)')

ax3.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Average Megapixels', fontsize=11, color='#2E86AB')
ax3_twin.set_ylabel('Cameras with 4K Video (%)', fontsize=11, color='#A23B72')
ax3.set_title('Camera Technology Evolution Over Time', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#2E86AB')
ax3_twin.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#A23B72')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

lines = line1 + line2
labels = [l.get_label() for l in lines]
ax3.legend(lines, labels, loc='upper left', fontsize=9)

# 4. Weight vs Price Distribution by Body Type
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
body_types = df['body_type'].unique()
colors_body = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(body_types))
for i, body in enumerate(body_types):
    subset = df[df['body_type'] == body]
    ax4.scatter(subset['weight_grams'], subset['price_usd'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=50, label=body, color=colors_body[i])
ax4.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Price vs Weight by Body Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Body Type', fontsize=9, title_fontsize=10)
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
